lines.en: I usually wake up early.
On Monday, I go to the bank.
"I want to open a bank account."
I show my work pass.
lines.zh: 我出示了我的工作准证。

lines.en: On Wednesday, my phone has no data.
lines.zh: 星期三，我的手机没流量了。

lines.en: I top up my phone with the app.
lines.zh: 我用 app 给手机充值。

lines.en: On Saturday, I'm at the front desk at 10am.
lines.zh: 星期六上午 10 点，我在前台上班。

lines.en: Each class is one and a half hours.
After work, I swim for one hour.
lines.zh: 下班后，我游泳游了一个小时。

lines.en: Oh no! Where is my wallet?
It's at the front desk. Good!
Sometimes I forget my wallet.
lines.zh: 我有时候会忘了拿钱包。

dialogue.title: 老公的手机坏了
dialogue.setting: 星期天晚上，Amy 和老公 Ben 在家里商量这个星期要办的事。

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: Amy, my phone screen is broken.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Oh no! You need to change the screen.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: How much is it?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Maybe 80 dollars.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: That's a lot. I want to save money.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: The shop near the MRT is cheap.
lines.zh: MRT 站附近那家店便宜。

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: OK. Can you come with me?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Sorry, I work on Saturday.
lines.zh: 不好意思，我星期六要上班。

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: What about Sunday?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Sure. We can go after lunch.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: Don't forget, we need to pay the bill too.
lines.zh: 别忘了，我们还要交账单。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I can pay it on the app.
lines.zh: 我可以在 app 上交。

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: Good. You're very smart!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I know!
